title: Student Travel - Under Armour - Project Rampart - Baltimore, MD - Oakland Athletic League - Coliseum College Prep Academy
official_text: Adoption by the Board of Education of Resolution No. 2526-0050 - Authorization for Approval of Student Travel by school site Coliseum College Prep Academy for five 10th through 12th grade students and nine District Certificated and Central Staff members to visit Under Armour - Project Rampart, Baltimore, MD, for the period of April 4, 2026 through April 8, 2026.
headline: Approves Coliseum College Prep Academy trip to Under Armour's Project Rampart in Baltimore, April 4-8
summary: The Board is asked to approve student travel for Coliseum College Prep Academy. Five students in grades 10 through 12 and nine district teachers and central staff members would visit Under Armour's Project Rampart in Baltimore, Maryland, from April 4 through April 8, 2026. The item lists no fiscal impact.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
